findings.title: Custom corpus can have different effective resolution inputs without an explicit corpus equality failure
findings.detail: Native preparation verifies every indexed file belongs to spec but not that every supplied supported source is indexed; native verify checks tracked files == spec, not indexed files == spec. Native discovery skips target/node_modules and honors ignores, while SQL extracts every shared source.
findings.reproduction: Source-traced, not executed under read-only constraints: a complete spec containing src/lib.rs plus target/extra.rs with a unique function passes source/tracked checks; native excludes target/extra.rs, SQL extracts it. Search for the extra function yields a corpus-policy discrepancy; leaving it unqueried can hide the differing context.
findings.action: Parent must assert exact logical path/blob equality between native provenance indexed_files and SQL/shared source manifests for the final cohort, or explicitly reject/report any discovery gap. Preserve production index policy.
